lead: A `[context]` gap is closed by adding the path to `modules`, and there is no `files` field.
body: `bun nv orient` resolves every leftover `modules` pattern against the tracked files, so a goal may name a fixture, a tool or a `.nvst` case there, while a key the loader does not know is silently nothing at all. Add the path with `bun nv goal context --add <path>`, or put it in a `[context.stage.N] modules` overlay when only one stage reads it.
